BUYER CHANGELOG

JULY 2026

Baton Buyer Changelog: Welcome!

We're excited to share our first Baton Buyer Changelog, a running list of what's new, what's improved, and what's coming to help you find and close on a business. 

We hope this helps you make the most of the platform! 

— Reid, from the product team

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NEW

Your deals, all in one place

My Deals is now a full pipeline tracker!

 * Track every business by stage (Watchlist, Initial Diligence, Engaging with Seller, Offers & Negotiations, and Diligence & Closing) in a list or board view.

 * Keep every conversation moving with “New message" badges. They flag which deals are waiting on your reply, plus one click takes you straight to the conversation.

Fully supported on mobile, too.

 

[https://www.baton.com/market/saved-listings]

Check it out › [https://www.baton.com/market/saved-listings]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

New

Meet Elena, your AI analyst on every listing

Every for-sale listing now has Elena built right into the help panel — an AI analyst who answers your questions instantly from everything the listing contains. Ask about the asking price, revenue and margins, location, SBA eligibility, employee count, the owner's day-to-day and hours, why they're selling, lease terms, and more, and Elena pulls the answer from the listing profile, financials, the owner's walkthrough, and the advisor's curated FAQs. When a question really needs a person — pricing, financing, or negotiation — she hands you straight to the deal's advisor. Type a question or tap one of the suggested starters to begin.

[https://www.baton.com/market/businesses-for-sale]

Try it  › [https://www.baton.com/market/businesses-for-sale]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IMPROVED

Everything for a listing, on one page

We've redesigned the listing page to bring everything you need into one place.

The Data Room, FAQ, and your messages with the seller are now tabs right on the page instead of scattered across separate ones. The sidebar lays out your next steps. Ask a question, meet the seller, submit an informal offer, or submit a formal LOI with "Submitted" badges showing what's done and what's left. Plus, you can switch between tabs without losing your spot or your conversation with Elena.
